summary: Distinct Engineering Solutions (DESI) is a multidisciplinary civil engineering consultancy founded in 2008, headquartered at 425 Old Georges Road, North Brunswick, NJ, with satellite offices in New York and Connecticut and public/private clients across NJ, NY, PA and CT. It sells seven service lines (geotechnical, environmental/LSRP, site civil and permitting, special inspection, hazmat, noise/air, vibration monitoring) plus an AASHTO-accredited soil/concrete lab, largely to NYC and NJ public agencies and their contractors. The front door is a phone number, two generic email inboxes and one generic web form with no quote or booking flow, while the firm is simultaneously hiring for proposal, scheduling and project-control coordination roles.

facts.fact: Founded in 2008; main office in North Brunswick, NJ with satellite offices in New York and Connecticut; serves NJ, PA and the NY metropolitan area.

Employs over 30 staff, many licensed Professional Engineers, including a New Jersey Licensed Site Remediation Professional (LSRP); staff hold degrees in engineering, geology, hydrogeology and environmental science.
Runs an AASHTO-accredited and NYSDOB-approved materials testing laboratory in NJ and cites multiple ACEC NY awards up to Diamond level.
Head office address is 425 Old Georges Rd, North Brunswick, NJ 08902.
Contact page publishes NJ phone (732) 658-1052, NJ fax (732) 398-1699, NY phone (646) 863-6161, NY fax (646) 845-3262 and info@distinctengineering.com, but no street address or map.

Seven practice pages are listed on the Services page: Geotechnical Engineering, Environmental Investigation & Remediation, Vibration and Geo-Structural Monitoring, Hazmat & Mold Consulting, Noise & Air Consulting, Special Inspection and Construction Administration, Site Civil and Permitting.

Careers page says DESI plans to hire 8 entry-level engineers/scientists/inspectors, 2 experienced geotechnical/environmental engineers and 4 experienced construction inspectors with NICET II/III, citing increased workload, backlog from existing contracts and new opportunities.
Job applications are accepted by email only (careers@distinctengineering.com, attention Ms. Marie Morgan; some postings use hr@distinctengineering.com), with resume and cover letter.
A paid part-time, on-site internship titled 'Civil Engineering, AI Tooling, & Business Operations' (20-30 hrs/week, North Brunswick) was posted October 28, 2026.

A full-time, on-site Proposal Coordinator role in North Brunswick (0-3 years' experience) covers RFP/RFQ requirement review, deadline tracking, coordinating inputs from engineering/operations/finance, maintaining a proposal content library, and submitting proposals via online portals or email.

Qualifications page lists NJ/NY/CT/PA DBE and MBE certification, Port Authority NY&NJ MBE/DBE, NYC DOB-licensed Class I Special Inspection Agency, A2LA ISO/IEC 17020 accreditation (cert. 4048.01) and AASHTO lab accreditation for soil, concrete, masonry and quality management.
Major clients are NYC agencies: MTA Capital Construction, NYC DDC, NYC EDC, NYCHA, NYC DPR, NYC DSNY, NYC SCA, plus private developers.

Google Business Profile shows 2.1 stars, category 'Engineering consultant', address 425 Old Georges Rd, Friday hours 9 AM-6 PM, a (732) 658-1052 call link and no photos (the panel prompts visitors to add photos).

operations_signals: Front door is phone plus a single generic contact form; the form has fixed fields (name, email, phone, company, city, message) and no service selector, project-type or budget field, so geotech, hazmat and special-inspection enquiries all arrive in the same queue (https://distinct-esi.com/contact/).

Form is a WordPress Forminator form protected by reCAPTCHA and a hidden honeypot field labelled 'Please do not fill in this field.', which can silently discard automated or autofilled submissions (https://distinct-esi.com/contact/).
No online booking, quote calculator or client portal link anywhere in the navigation; the only conversion CTAs on the home page are 'OUR SERVICES' and 'CONTACT US' (https://distinct-esi.com/).

Phone numbers are tel: links (click-to-call) on the contact page, but on a 390 px view the number sits near the bottom of the page and the mobile header is a hamburger with no sticky call button (https://distinct-esi.com/contact/).
Contact page omits the street address and any embedded map, so a visitor must go to Google or a job posting to find the North Brunswick office (https://distinct-esi.com/contact/).

Clients page states services are provided '24/7, if needed', implying after-hours field and emergency response coverage without a published on-call number or escalation route (https://distinct-esi.com/clients/).
Published office hours are 9:00 AM-5:00 PM Mon-Fri in job postings, while the Google profile shows 9 AM-6 PM for Friday (https://distinct-esi.com/careers/perm-postings/).
Inbound applications are handled by email rather than an ATS: candidates send resumes to careers@ or hr@ and HR sorts them manually (https://distinct-esi.com/careers/).
hiring_signals: Careers page plans 14+ hires: 8 entry-level engineers/scientists/inspectors, 2 experienced geotechnical/environmental engineers, 4 NICET II/III construction inspectors (https://distinct-esi.com/careers/).

Scheduling Coordinator (full-time, on-site, North Brunswick): coordinates inspectors' daily schedules, communicates with clients and project managers, and tracks/reviews inspection reports — a dispatch-and-report-chasing role (https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/scheduling-coordinator-at-distinct-engineering-solutions-inc-4465325907).

Proposal Coordinator (full-time, on-site, 0-3 years): RFP/RFQ compliance tracking, proposal library upkeep and submission through client portals (https://www.mediabistro.com/jobs/3542836748-proposal-coordinator).

Project Controller (Civil Engineer): project cost tracking, invoicing, vendor coordination, AR/AP, timesheets and project setup; QuickBooks/Excel preferred (https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/project-controller-civil-engineer-at-distinct-engineering-solutions-inc-4458288771).

Paid part-time intern for 'Civil Engineering, AI Tooling, & Business Operations' posted 2026-10-28 — the firm is already experimenting with AI tooling internally (https://firstroles.com/jobs/9a2aaffd-1d64-4a3d-a43f-9f5268f050d4).
Blog doubles as a hiring channel: a 'POSITION AVAILABLE: FIELD SPECIAL INSPECTOR' notice is published as a blog post rather than on the careers page (https://distinct-esi.com/blog/).

PERM labor-certification notices for Environmental Engineer and Field Special Inspector ($95,000-$120,000, 40 hrs/week, Mon-Fri 9-5) were posted 09/12/2025 and removed 10/02/2025 (https://distinct-esi.com/careers/perm-postings/).
review_themes: Google rating is 2.1 stars with no review count or review text exposed in the limited Maps view, and the profile has no photos — the owner has not added imagery or visibly solicited reviews (https://www.google.com/maps/place/Distinct+Engineering+Solutions,+Inc./@40.4346013,-74.4850476,17z).

The website carries no testimonials, case-study quotes or review widget on any page inspected, so satisfied public-agency clients are not converted into public social proof (https://distinct-esi.com/).

No client-facing review body could be opened: BBB returned a bot challenge and LinkedIn/Glassdoor/Indeed returned 403, so client-side themes beyond the Google score are unverified (https://www.bbb.org/us/nj/n-brunswick/profile/civil-engineer/distinct-engineering-solutions-0221-90195752).
tech_footprint: Site runs WordPress with Elementor page builder; contact form is Forminator with reCAPTCHA (visible forminator_nonce and g-recaptcha-response fields) (https://distinct-esi.com/contact/).
Google Tag Manager (GTM-K4RKJJ3Q) and a GA4 gtag property (G-KN1S2CPNTN) are installed sitewide, so traffic data exists but no conversion/CRM link is visible (https://distinct-esi.com/).
No JSON-LD structured data at all on the home page, and the meta description tag is absent (page title is 'Distinct esi – Civil Engineering New Jersey NJ') (https://distinct-esi.com/).

Corporate summary claims a 'paperless office', desktop network fax, an online digital library and a growing client extranet, but no extranet or portal login is linked anywhere in the site navigation (https://distinct-esi.com/corporate-summary/).

Firm publishes certification PDFs (A2LA, NYC DOB, PANYNJ DBE) and links to the AASHTO accreditation directory — a content-rich but unstructured document library (https://distinct-esi.com/qualifications/).
News page is linked in the main navigation but renders empty (heading only), while the Blog carries project notes and a job ad (https://distinct-esi.com/news/).
growth_signals: Careers page attributes hiring to 'increase in workload and backlog work from existing contracts and many new opportunities' (https://distinct-esi.com/careers/).

Back-office capacity is being added: the Proposal Coordinator role is newly created around a growing public/private project pipeline, and a Project Controller role covers cost tracking, invoicing, AR/AP and timesheets (https://www.mediabistro.com/jobs/3542836748-proposal-coordinator).

Recognition page lists ACEC NY Diamond, Platinum, Gold and Silver awards across MTA 7 Line Extension, Second Avenue Subway, Rockaway Boardwalk, Route 209 Bridge, Red Hook Houses and Belmont Runyon School (https://distinct-esi.com/awards/).

Certifications cover NJ, NY, CT and PA plus PANYNJ, DASNY, NYC SCA, NJ DPMC, NJ Turnpike and PennDOT ECMS prequalification — a multi-state public-sector growth base (https://distinct-esi.com/qualifications/).

Blog project notes show active work on the LIRR Expansion (~9.8 miles of new track), NYCHA Sandy rehabilitation geotech, a Morris County bridge replacement and bulkhead rehabilitation (https://distinct-esi.com/blog/).

A New York phone line (646) 863-6161 is published on the site and the corporate summary claims a Connecticut satellite, indicating reach beyond the North Brunswick base (https://distinct-esi.com/contact/).
physical_signals: Head office at 425 Old Georges Rd, North Brunswick, NJ 08902 — a single suburban office address used for HR correspondence (https://distinct-esi.com/careers/perm-postings/).

In-house materials testing laboratory in North Brunswick, AASHTO-accredited for soil, concrete, masonry and quality management, and licensed by NYC DOB as a Class I Special Inspection Agency/concrete laboratory (https://distinct-esi.com/qualifications/).
A2LA ISO/IEC 17020 accreditation certificate 4048.01 is posted with an expiry of June 30, 2026 — renewal paperwork falls due within months of this review (https://distinct-esi.com/qualifications/).

Field-heavy operation: inspectors and field personnel are deployed to construction and remediation sites across NYC and NJ (bridges, tunnels, bulkheads, LIRR track, NYCHA housing), so work is scheduled by job site rather than at a fixed desk (https://distinct-esi.com/corporate-summary/).
Corporate summary distinguishes office professional staff from 'field personnel', consistent with a split office/field workforce of 30+ people (https://distinct-esi.com/corporate-summary/).
decision_maker: Unknown — no owner, president or principal is named on the company's own site (the corporate summary refers only to 'DESI's President'). The only named person on the site is Ms. Marie Morgan, listed as the careers/hiring contact at careers@distinctengineering.com (https://distinct-esi.com/careers/).

inferences.inference: A scheduling/dispatch agent would address a real, currently staffed pain point: field inspector deployment and inspection-report chasing are important enough that DESI created a dedicated Scheduling Coordinator role.
inferences.reasoning: The Scheduling Coordinator posting describes daily coordination of inspectors' schedules plus tracking and reviewing inspection reports, work that is repetitive, rules-based and phone/email heavy.

inferences.inference: Proposal and bid administration is the highest-density AI opportunity in the back office.
inferences.reasoning: A newly created Proposal Coordinator role is dominated by reading RFP/RFQ requirements, tracking deadlines and addenda, assembling boilerplate resumes and project sheets, and uploading packages to agency portals — all document-heavy, template-driven work the firm is currently hiring humans for.

inferences.inference: Billing and project accounting likely runs on spreadsheets plus QuickBooks, with manual invoice/AR follow-up.
inferences.reasoning: The Project Controller posting lists cost tracking, invoicing, AR/AP, timesheets and project setup, preferring QuickBooks/Excel, which suggests no integrated ERP or automated collections workflow.

inferences.inference: The 2.1 Google rating is a credibility drag mainly on recruiting and small private-client search, not on public-agency procurement.
inferences.reasoning: Public work comes through prequalification and RFP portals, but candidates and small developers do check Google; the profile has a low score, no photos and no review-request workflow on the site.

inferences.inference: Enquiry triage is manual and error-prone because every service line funnels into one generic form.
inferences.reasoning: Seven distinct service lines with very different scoping questions share a six-field contact form, and the honeypot/reCAPTCHA combination can drop legitimate automated or autofilled messages.

inferences.inference: There is latent internal appetite for AI tooling.
inferences.reasoning: The firm posted a paid internship explicitly pairing civil engineering with 'AI Tooling & Business Operations' in October 2026, which implies an internal sponsor experimenting with automation rather than a purely top-down purchase.

inferences.inference: The firm's extranet and document library are probably less mature than the corporate summary implies.
inferences.reasoning: No client portal login is linked from any page and the News page renders empty, pointing to ad-hoc document practices behind the 'paperless office' claim.

data_gaps: Google review text and review count were not accessible: Maps served a limited panel showing only the 2.1 score, and no review bodies could be opened.
BBB, Glassdoor, Indeed and LinkedIn blocked automated access (403 / Cloudflare bot check), so employee and client review themes are unverified beyond search-result summaries.
No revenue, headcount beyond 'over 30 staff', or org chart published; the president's name is not on the company's own site and third-party directories disagree, so no decision-maker is recorded.
Connecticut satellite office address is not published anywhere on the site; only NJ and NY phone lines are listed.
No information on which CRM, project-management, accounting or field-inspection software DESI uses internally (only public web tooling is observable).
No public records were checked for this firm: FMCSA and local health inspections are not applicable, and OSHA establishment data / NJ building permits were not confirmed within this session.
